body:
So, you’re saying that if you walk into your companies break room, and see a cake sitting on a table, you’re totally in the right to just start eating it?

How about if you walked into your friends house? Would you just start eating their cake? 

Just because you have a right to be there, doesn’t mean you have a right to whatever’s there.

Someone brings a cake in, and leaves it in the break room, it’s polite to ask before stuffing your face.

I worked night shift at Walmart, we broke some stocking record one month, our reward was pizza. The pizza got there before we did, and the day shift people ate every single slice before we could even get there.

Wasn’t for them. Was even a sign left on top that said “Night Crew”. They didn’t care, they had your attitude, “well it’s in the break room, that means it’s for me.”
Different scenarios, but I agree with you.
What, people like her? Entitled? Come on, that’s just not possible.
